bead.title: Verify RESP XREADGROUP claimed-item field parity
bead.description: PROBLEM: The RESP surface still only has a static claimed-item shape check, so it does not independently prove parity with the library claim result after `update_fields`. ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-resp/tests/e2e.rs:250` asserts the XREADGROUP reply shape once, but it does not drive a post-`update_fields` claim nor compare the RESP entry to the library-facing claimed-item shape. PROPOSED FIX: extend the RESP e2e to push an item, mutate `fields`, issue `XREADGROUP`, and assert the reply carries the current structured fields and reserved-field behavior exactly as the claim contract requires; compare the RESP entry to the library claim result where available. This extends the closed claimed-shape work (`pqueue-9c77d5e7` / `pqueue-922eaf00`). NON-SCOPE: backend storage internals, conformance-traceability docs, and API-003 workflow logic.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestRespXreadgroupClaimShapeParity: `cargo test -p pqueue-resp --test e2e xreadgroup_returns_api001_claimed_item_shape -- --nocapture` passes after the RESP reply is checked against the updated claim-field contract.
2. TestRespReservedFieldAndFieldMapRegression: the RESP test also asserts reserved-field handling and claim-field parity after `update_fields` on the same queue.
3. TestGoTestGate: `go test ./...` passes.
4. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
